prompts.punchPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a whole-body cel animation sheet of EXACTLY the Asian male DJ Volt from the reference. 12 full-body drawings in 4 columns and 3 rows, row-major order, TRANSPARENT background. Same face, costume, proportions, camera and body scale in every drawing. Lime hair, cyan forehead goggles, pink headphones, orange 99 jersey, purple cargo trousers, cream inline skates pink wheels. Microphone stays in anatomical RIGHT hand on viewer LEFT near his mouth throughout. LEFT free hand on viewer right performs gestures. Sharp cel shading and clean outlines. No labels, no floor shadows, no grid. Complete hair hands wheels inside every cell with generous margins and gutters. Both feet stay planted at identical coordinates, equal ground line for every frame. Begin and end with the exact top-left reference neutral performance stance. No perspective or size changes. Action: playful rhythmic PUNCH AND CHOP dance inspired by snappy paper-character rhythm-game movement. Frames 1-3: neutral to anticipation, free left elbow pulls back beside ribs and torso winds slightly left. Frames 4-5: free left fist punches outward to viewer right at shoulder height, bold readable accent. Frame 6: elbow bends halfway back. Frames 7-8: open left palm sweeps diagonally down across torso with soft knee bend, a rhythmic chop. Frames 9-12: free hand opens back outward at waist and torso untwists, smoothly settling into EXACT neutral first pose. Closely spaced in-between drawings, clear anticipation, accented extension, follow-through and complete recovery. Mic never switches hands. Grounded feet never slide.
